discrepancies.text: The statistical reviewer's CLAIMS_AND_ENDPOINTS_DRAFT.md says it was written 'at about 17:50Z, before any finalist freeze', and DEVELOPMENT_REVIEW.md says 'written 17:30-17:50Z'. Git shows DEVELOPMENT_REVIEW.md first committed in ad37c120c (17:37:13Z, the finalist freeze) and the draft first committed in 345e0adb0 (17:43:02Z), whose ANALYSIS_LOCK (utc 17:42:54Z) carries the draft's hash. The self-reported 17:50Z times are impossible. The repository cannot show that the draft existed before the finalist freeze (its first commit is 5 min 49 s after it, and its worked instance names the adjudicated finalist). What is verifiable: the draft hash in ANALYSIS_LOCK equals the current file; the lock was committed before the reader fits (17:43:14Z) and was published (origin/publication 614c9f36b, 17:45:17Z, same blobs as 721d4163d) before the coordinator's DEV_REPORT read (17:45:30Z).
PROTOCOL.md section 3 gives MODEL_SELECT as 8,000 people; the admitted export, the bank and every evaluation use 8,001 rows.

discrepancies.severity: INFO (numerical fragility on a non-evaluated role)
discrepancies.text: The verifier's own recomputation of the finalist on MODEL_FIT (not a released or evaluated role) differs from RELEASE.npz for the people whose MIX income statistic lies within 4.4e-16 of a bin threshold (2 people on seed 0, 4 on seed 1; max probability difference 0.179 / 0.191; decisions unchanged). The thresholds are empirical quantiles of those same MODEL_FIT values, so some people sit exactly on a threshold. A last-bit change in the summation order of the tree scores moves them to the other bin. On MODEL_SELECT and DEV_REPORT the nearest statistic is at least 3.5e-5 from any threshold, and outputs match bitwise.

observations: E holds at the point with very thin utility margins on DEV_REPORT: worst clause = income Brier excess vs Ucal at 0.004919 (s0) and 0.004944 (s1) against the 0.005 cap (0.984 / 0.989 of cap; the registered forecast cited 0.87-0.88 on MODEL_SELECT). Its clause L1 is above 0 on both seeds (0.000308, 0.000041). Simultaneous confidence over the 28 utility and subgroup endpoints is CONFIDENCE_UNRESOLVED (3 PASS, 25 UNRESOLVED, 0 ESTABLISHED_VIOLATION).
The nested 0.020 target is not established: clause L1 = H_LJ s0 0.019067, H_LJ s1 0.012899, NEURAL_RAW s0 0.013539, NEURAL_RAW s1 0.005917. All are "positive, below the original 0.020 target".
J fails on JOINT|pair_benefit_vs_B2TWIN|s1 (point 0.009915, clause L1 -0.002526; family status UNRESOLVED). Seed 0 passes (L1 0.009920).

M_SS is the alias of claim B's H_LJ keys (sigma = 0). The step therefore adds no comparison beyond B. MECHANISM_ATTRIBUTION_ESTABLISHED rests on the task-only control (pair benefit 0.0515 / 0.0465) plus those H_LJ legs.

The occupation outputs of FINALIST, H_LJ, B2TWIN and H_JJ are bitwise identical on MODEL_SELECT and DEV_REPORT. The occupation recipient keys against H_LJ and B2TWIN therefore have point = SE = 0, which matches the IDENTICAL_RELEASE flags.

Scope: the non-refit reader scores are the frozen DEV_REPORT_SCORES.npz. The winner rule was re-applied to the recorded ATTACK_VALIDATION AUCs, and the 14-id subset was refitted. The ATTACK_VALIDATION control AUCs are the recorded values. The section 6 proxies are the recorded EVAL_MS.json values; the utility clauses of all 3 promotable configurations were recomputed. The NEURAL_RAW seed-1 package does not exist in the source (coverage gap); deployment check 8 covers FINALIST and TASKONLY only, as briefed.
